_comment: 8d E1 (issue #14) 'What the Seal Kept' -- THE FULL END-TO-END FIGHT-ROUTE PROOF: accept at Olesm -> travel to the reopened gallery -> recruit the Horns (Ceria) -> FIGHT the promoted snare -> the vault boss (4-ally party, windup live) -> the FIND beat -> report, quest_completed. Loads delve_fight_start (street, facing Olesm, quest fresh, T4 gear/classes -- the ONLY canonical resolving BOTH the trapped_halls_snare skirmish and the vault fight to completion). Teleports across the ALREADY-tested sewers/deep_tunnels stretch (dungeon_peek's own teleport-only precedent) -- the SUBJECT here is the delve itself, not re-proving pre-existing travel. TRAP: Olesm's hub option list is cursor-index-navigated (olesm_intro.json's own documented trap) -- the accept option sits at VISIBLE index 6 (options 0-5 unrelated/visible-locked entries, this fixture's own accomplishment set), and by the report visit the SAME visible index 6 holds the report option (the accept option hides on horns_delve_started exactly as the report option reveals on seal_kept_found -- re-derive both indices together if any olesm_intro.json option gate changes).

steps._comment: == ACCEPT at Olesm (29,3) -- visible index 6. Olesm carries a real `talk_pool` (cisterns_reported's own stage bark, since this fixture's backbone includes it) that fires on the FIRST interact of the waking, BEFORE his conversation graph -- a first interact consumes it, the second opens olesm_intro for real (interact()'s documented talk_pool-then-conversation order).
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: The Watch wants eyes on the reopened gallery — proper eyes. The last guardsman down there filed three words: 'it is dark.' Five gold now, fifteen when you bring me something I can put in a report. The Guild is sending a Silver-rank team to meet you there.

steps._comment: == teleport across the already-tested sewers/deep_tunnels stretch, landing beside warren_mouth (12,5) -- the SAME dungeon_peek precedent, a fresh move to establish real facing.
== the gallery reopens: horns_delve_started is banked, so warren_mouth's door_when now transitions instead of the old flavor toast.
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: The gallery floor slopes down past where the den used to be, into a chamber someone else has clearly been surveying.

steps._comment: == find Ceria (7,5) -- row 6 is clear the whole way, bump up onto her occupied cell to face her.

payload_contains.text: You're the one Olesm's paying to poke the gallery? Good. The Guild sent us along to make sure you come back out. Ceria Springwalker — Horns of Hammerad.
Rules are simple. Traps kill more adventurers than monsters do, so nobody touches anything shiny. See something worth grabbing, you call me over and you wait.
All right. Four of us on the roster, three of us actually walking in — Pisces bills from a distance. Try to keep up.

steps._comment: == into trapped_halls via the real new door pair.
== FIGHT ROUTE: the snare (17,8) -- row 8 is clear the whole way. Interact fields no ally (solo), wins on the T4 build.

the crate_fight/cisterns_fight idiom: combat_finished (the UI banner event, NOT the bare combat_resolved domain event) with a real animation-time timeout, THEN a confirm press dismisses the banner -- resolve_combat()'s on_victory bank (halls_cleared) fires off THAT press, not automatically.
== THE VAULT (18,6) -- halls_cleared now met (the encounter_when gate opens) and horns_party_formed already banked (ally_requires met): the FULL 4-body Horns party fields.

Issue #76: the arena-keyed music seam (data/audio.json's music_combat_vault, `combat_started`/{arena:vault}, first-match-wins ahead of the generic music_combat fallback) -- proves the vault boss actually gets its own escalated track, not the plain field-fight loop.
Issue #76: the windup mechanism's audio half -- skill_windup_tell fires alongside every windup_declared (slam is the only current grant), a distinct telegraph tell from the resolve-impact sound.
== THE FIND beat: seal_kept_door (19,7), post-victory variant.

payload_contains.text: The runes are the same. Not similar — the same hand, the same order, as the door in the inn's pantry.

steps._comment: == REPORT: teleport back to Olesm, same visible index 6 (the accept option hid exactly as the report option revealed).

payload_contains.text: A construct. A vault. Another rune-door — another. Do you know what this does to my casualty projections? Nothing good. Here is your fifteen. Earned.

steps._comment: Issue #76: this canonical's two real fights land at least one PC hit (empirically confirmed: rift_vermin_c/snare_ward_a connect on the T4 build) -- whole-run scan for the PC hurt bark (pc_hurt, Voice bus), the same coverage-map idiom inventory_loop uses for its own audio_played proofs.
